headline: LAD @ CHW matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAD 5.86 at CHW 4.26, with a projected total of 10.12. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAD: LAD moved +1.33 runs while CHW moved +1.08, changing the projected margin by +0.26 runs. The projected total climbed +2.41, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -13.6%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Emmet Sheehan has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Shohei Ohtani, Miguel Vargas, Chase Meidroth, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Edgar Quero because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
